description: Minimal capability set for the main window. Grants core Tauri primitives, notification:default (one aggregate 'N new messages' OS notification after a background/manual sync; counts only, never subjects or senders), a single scoped opener permission (opener:allow-open-url restricted to `https://*`, used to launch the OAuth2 consent screen in the system browser, RFC 8252 external agent), and the attachment file-dialog permissions dialog:allow-open + dialog:allow-save (native open/save-file pickers for attachments and save-as). File contents are read/written by Rust std::fs commands against the dialog-chosen path (ADR-0010): tauri-plugin-fs is registered but granted NO scope here, so the webview has no standing filesystem access. No path opening (open_path), no reveal-in-dir, no mailto/tel/http scheme, no message/ask/confirm dialogs, and no shell or arbitrary-network permissions.
